QuestInfo.name: [Hieizan Temple] The Demon King Returns
QuestInfo.0: Princess No was waiting for you when you entered the central hall, with all her underlings you already eliminated... What is she up to?
QuestInfo.1: Princess No was able to summon the Demon King, but he refused to take orders from her. Instead she has been filled with devilish and wicked powers.
